name: The Stacks
description: A trading post on the rooftops above the drowned city, run by the grandchildren of people who walked the causeway north. Nothing is bought with money here — everything is weighed, including the things you would rather not put on a scale.

variants.description: A trading post on the rooftops, busier than it has any right to be, with a swimming line strung between two chimneys and a queue of children on it. Somebody told the causeway generation the roofs would hold, and they believed it enough to stay.

A trading post on the rooftops, thinner than it should be. Told the truth about how long it would take, the causeway generation stopped coming north a decade before the water did. Their grandchildren are not here, because there are no grandchildren.
